task: closed-loop drive of RDR: read the title screen, press START via xdotool, capture the following screens
result: NO SUCH CAPTURE EXISTS. The title screen is the last thing the guest ever draws; the SPURS abort kills it during the title's own fade-in. Proven with a same-minute A/B, both arms recorded at 60 fps: with START held in every pad read (input queue 'start 100000', 331 polls in W-P / 588 in POST-P, bytes 00 7c 08 00 80 80 80 80) the title occupies 4-11 video frames and the window is then gone; with an empty queue and no input it occupies 0-9 frames and the window is then gone. The guest stops calling cellPadGetData at game t=21.56 s and the title is not drawn until t~22.85 s, so no press -- held, tapped, queued or via X -- can reach the title's wait-for-START routine inside its lifetime. The blocker is the DMA GET REFUSED at ea 0, not the input path; the input path is proven good.
